newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: MOTOR RACING-LAMY WRITES OFF MINARDI IN TESTING.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-LAMY WRITES OFF MINARDI IN TESTING.

text.p: Portuguese Formula One driver Pedro Lamy crashed and wrecked his Minardi-Ford while testing at Estoril circuit on Wednesday but escaped unharmed.
Lamy lost control of his car and slammed into the rails at a bend. Further testing at the circuit was halted until the rails were repaired.
Several Formula One teams remained at Estoril after last Sunday's Portuguese Grand Prix, won by Canadian Jacques Villeneuve.
